case_name: Dipak Kumar Yadav vs Personnel And Adminis Reform

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dipak Kumar Yadav, son of Late Vishwaranjan Yadav
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Jharkhand through Secretary, Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Government of Jharkhand, Deputy Commissioner, Singhbhum East, Deputy Collector(Establishment) Singhbhum East, Civil Surgeon-cum-Chief Medical Officer, Singhbhum East

facts_of_case: Petitioner's father died in harness. Petitioner claimed appointment on compassionate ground. Application was forwarded to Deputy Commissioner, East Singhbhum for consideration. Case was placed before District Compassionate Appointed Committee but ultimately rejected.

legal_principles.principle: Children born out of a void marriage are legitimate
legal_principles.held: Section 16(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act provides that notwithstanding a marriage is null and void, any child of such marriage who would have been legitimate if the marriage had been valid, shall be legitimate.

legal_principles.principle: Illegitimate children are natural sons born out of a marriage
legal_principles.held: The illegitimate son is also a natural son born out of the marriage which may be void.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's claim for appointment on compassionate ground has been turned down by the State.
